mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% reflects a weakening labor market that triggers risk-off sentiment, resulting in negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where both HOUST < 1700 and RSAFS < 550000.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the increased cost of capital and reduced liquidity lead to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing output contraction indicated by INDPRO below 100 reduces corporate profitability expectations, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 260 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and produce negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 260.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in employment growth (PAYEMS < 143000) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%) signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where both PAYEMS < 143000 and UNRATE > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions (GDPC1 > 18000), sustained corporate earnings growth and investor confidence produce positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 > 18000.
